nodes.label: ShellSmash Coming Soon / Próximamente Screen Concept Art
nodes.description: Concept art for the Shell Smash Gaming Hub 'Coming Soon' (Próximamente) screen. Features a large turtle warrior character on the left and four locked upcoming feature cards on the right: Modo Torneo (compete in epic tournaments), Clanes (join a clan, fight allies, climb ranking), Eventos Especiales (time-limited events with rewards and challenges), and Más Minijuegos (new mini-games to discover). A 'Sigue Entrenando' motivational footer and a 'Volver al Hub' CTA button are shown. Top bar shows currency: 3,450 coins, 180 gems, 25 tokens.
